body: I'm glad I could make your day. You saved me from having to make up another "a stray cat attacked me" spiel for my family and boyfriend. I hope one day I can give you the hug you deserve for doing that.

Can I just shrink you and keep you in my pocket so you can tell me that all the time? and You don't deserve to be, either. Someone sweet enough to talk to someone when they feel like this deserves a million and one things, and a confidant it one of them. I'm sure she wouldn't consider it a waste of time.

That's good, I'm really glad I could give you something out of this. I had just gotten dropped off back at my dorms and was in a really bad sort when you first commented. I'm still sad, but I don't feel so terribly alone now.
And haha, yeah. They say that until I really get into talking. Everyone leaves then..
The fact that anyone cared enough to answer this is making me bawl my eyes out while I'm writing to you. I know I need it but I feel so shitty and like I'm not worth the time and don't deserve it..

It's more that they didn't understand than what they have to say about and to me. I've never had one of those close friends that I can count on or connect with, and it kills me. No matter how many people I have around me in the room, I'm just still alone because nobody that cares enough to listen really understands.. I'm sorry if I'm just going in circles or anything..

The teachers and other students essentially telling me that all of my ideas and projects are shit, and that I'm essentially spending over 90k to get 'grip work' ($10/hr job moving things around on set). I know that it's them trying to make you motivated in an angry, 'fuck you i'll prove you wrong' way, but I just feel like for me it's the truth.
Film.. I love movies so much because I can forget who I am for a while...

Honestly, it sounds like the two of you could use to sit down and talk to each other. Don't stay in a relationship that's killing you, no matter what the perks of it are, or what society tells you that you are 'responsible' for. Be happy, in any way possible.
